content: Order of distillation and fine-tuning: Most of the existing work on distilling language models such as BERT and reporting results on downstream tasks, including some of the baselines in this work, first fine-tune a teacher model on the downstream tasks, and then distill this model. Our goal in this work, however, is to explore the limits to which BERT's language modeling capacity itself, and how much of it is driven by its large WordPiece vocabulary. We leave experiments on distilling fine-tuned teacher models, potentially yielding better results on downstream tasks, to future work.
